name: Helena
message: 「Being the chairwoman is exhausting. My shoulders are so stiff」

name: Helena
message: 「Surprised? Even I'm not completely perfect, you know? Well, I somehow manage to make it look that way, though」

name: Helena
message: 「Being the one in charge is tough, you know」

name: Helena
message: 「A shoulder-massage coupon? Whoa. It feels like it's been ages since I last saw one of these」

name: Helena
message: 「A birthday present for me? Because you don't have any money, you went with this?」

name: Helena
message: 「Well then, maybe I'll have you do it right away! La-la-la ♪」
